in_sanskrit.name: आश्विना
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Ashvins (Ashwinikumaras) are the gods of healing, the rainy season, and the horses. They are also known as the physicians of the gods. They are mentioned in the Rigveda, the earliest scripture of Hinduism.

in_hindi.name: अश्विना
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ashwina is derived from the Sanskrit word आश्विन (Aashvina), which means 'Goddess of the Ashvins (horses)'. The Ashvins are the gods of healing, the rainy season, and the horses.

in_marathi.name: Ashwina
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ashwina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Ashwina refers to the twin horse gods, the Ashvins. They are the physicians of the gods and are invoked for well-being and healing.
